scope: Integration review for this staged authoring change; final package acceptance is separately enforced by verify-adaptive-all-views.mjs.

closedFindings.issue: Mixed selection copies non-edited padding sides from the first widget and clears their view declarations.
closedFindings.resolution: Inspector supplies single-side intent; App resolves that intent against each target. Equal-value targets retain all declarations. Original failed source and candidate bytes are retained.

closedFindings.issue: Old test asserted full tuple storage after a local edit.
closedFindings.resolution: Assert sparse storage plus complete effective tuple after save/reopen and unchanged Base. First complete run retained with one failure; final complete unit run passes.

closedFindings.issue: A blanket global effect edit did not preserve the original first-effect branch.
closedFindings.resolution: Empty prior effective state graph uses current-view slot; existing graphs use whole-map global update. Dedicated CIL evidence and model/browser cases retained.

limitations: Original Axure GUI/canvas operations and pixel equivalence remain unverified; this stage uses static CIL evidence and independent product tests.
Native Layer/master/contained-owner, temporary provider, and named-style special propagation are not fully reproduced.
Arbitrary four-corner radii and four-side widths remain product extensions, not native uniform-value plus visibility-mask equivalence.
Complete RP/RPLIB import, native write-back and full Axure feature parity are unfinished.
